priors_recorded_before_run.expectation: v1 is expected to tie transformer_ko (0.490) and the sign arm is expected to be a wash. If it is, imputed signs are a layer with provenance and no measured use, which is worth knowing before anything is built on them

verdict: CELLFORMER v1 reaches metric-1 recall@50 0.4393 +/- 0.0315 against a tide floor of 0.2910 and an oracle of 0.6395, and metric-2 recall 0.0300 on the residual after the rank-20 shared core is projected out. THE NEIGHBOURHOOD IS THE ONLY THING THAT CLEARLY PAYS: full minus self-only +0.1340, full minus random partners +0.1853. THE SIGN CHANNEL IS NOT DETECTED at -0.0083 over its own SHUFFLED-sign control -- scored against shuffled sign, never against no-sign, because sign-over-nothing conflates 'sign matters' with 'an extra channel matters'. The relation-specific attention bias is worth +0.0114. Observed pooled seed sd is 0.0261, so the minimum detectable increment at 3 seeds is +0.0453: any delta inside that band is UNDERPOWERED, not null (2/4 of the reported deltas are). This is v1 for the current task and says nothing about mixed-curvature geometry, sheaf layers, hypergraph events, continuous time or multimodal heads.
limits: this is v1 for the CURRENT task -- ranking specific movers for a held-out knockout in one cell type at one timepoint. It is not a whole-cell model and the staged versions above it are untested hypotheses

the readout has ~0.12 of headroom between the tide floor and the retrieval oracle, and six architectural levers have each moved it by <= 0.02. Metric 1 may be unable to separate v1 from transformer_ko whatever v1 is worth, which is why metric 2 is computed
metric 2's shared core is fitted on training perturbations only, so it is leak-free, but k=20 is taken from CELLFORMER2.md rather than re-selected here
assay and time metadata are CONSTANT in this deposit. The slot exists so v4 can vary it; it carries no information now and must not be read as a tested channel

depmap_vecs.npz is per-gene z-scored, so gene-effect LEVELS are not available from it and nothing level-dependent may be derived from it. Essentiality therefore comes from the cell object's own `ess` field -- the same source transformer_ko used -- and is guarded by a canary on five core ribosome/spliceosome/polymerase genes

the DepMap profile per token is compressed to 64 SVD components for CPU tractability, which is a lossy change from transformer_ko's raw 1,150-column profile and could by itself move the comparison. Any v1-vs-transformer_ko difference must be attributed to this before it is attributed to the architecture
token budget is capped at 24, split across four relation types, so a knockout with many partners is truncated. Which partners survive truncation is the list order, not a ranking

SCOPE: this is v1 of a staged plan. It tests typed relational attention plus a sign channel.
It does NOT test mixed-curvature geometry, sheaf layers, hypergraph events, continuous time,
multimodal heads or whole-cell simulation, and claims nothing about them.

POWER, BEFORE THE ARMS: at 3 seeds and the sd of 0.03 this readout has shown across
six previous levers, the smallest increment separable at ~3 standard errors is +0.0520.
Every architectural lever tried on this readout so far has produced |delta| <= 0.02. An arm
that lands inside 0.0520 is UNDERPOWERED, not null, and is reported as such.
token type mix: self 6%, codep 28%, complex 15%, ppi 30%, reg 21%
